errorCodes.meaning: The request revokes as `member` for a DID the requester neither is nor holds a live session attach of on the connection that carried the request.
A member DID's record changed under concurrent writes too many times for the revocation to be committed, and nothing was revoked. Send the request again.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GrantId.description: A grant's identifier, chosen by the member DID's signer and carried in its grant statement; a UUID is RECOMMENDED. A mediator refuses a grant whose identifier is already on the member DID's record.
GrantId.title: GrantId

GrantRef.description: Identifies one stored grant and the two parties to it.

principal.description: The principal DID the grant delegates to.

GrantRef.title: GrantRef

MuxDid.description: A DID, carried verbatim and compared by exact string equality. Unlike the messaging family's `Vid`, never a hash: the mediator resolves it to verify a statement signed by it. For a member DID reached over TSP, the TSP VID is the DID itself.
MuxDid.title: MuxDid

MuxRole.description: The side of a delegation a requester acts as. `principal`: the DID that authenticated the connection and to which members' traffic is delegated. `member`: a DID whose traffic is delegated.
MuxRole.title: MuxRole

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/revoke request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/revoke/0.1#response.

revoked.description: Grants this request deleted; their members are detached from every connection before this response is sent, and the principal's replay floor rises so their statements cannot be stored again.

unmatchedDids.description: Requested DIDs with no stored grant the requester may revoke in the role it named.

unmatchedGrantIds.description: Requested grant identifiers that name no stored grant the requester may revoke in the role it named.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Revoke — response payload

schema.description: Revoke stored grants, as their principal or as their member DID. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

as.description: `principal`: revoke grants delegated to the requester. `member`: revoke grants on a member DID the requester controls.

did.description: As `member` only: the member DID whose grants are revoked; absent means the requester itself.

dids.description: As `principal`: member DIDs whose grants to the requester are revoked. As `member`: principal DIDs whose grants on the member are revoked.

schema.title: Messaging — Mux Revoke — payload
